haiku.problem: The group explanation adds a new backstory reference, "I'm a cookie stamper who spent years worn out in a junk drawer," which the lesson explanation does not have. It also turns the lesson's observation about a worn-out stamper into a first-person claim, "I've seen a kind word do more for me," which adds a fact not in the lesson explanation. This breaks the rules to add nothing new and to add no references the lesson explanation doesn't have.
